summary: Baileys fork resolves libsignal dependency from an unpinned personal GitHub repo
details: package.json declares the `libsignal` dependency as `github:tenka-san/libsignal-node` with no commit SHA, tag, or other integrity pin. On `npm install`, npm clones whatever currently sits at the default branch of that personal GitHub repository and installs it, executing any lifecycle scripts the cloned repo declares at install time and loading its code when Baileys is required. Whoever controls that GitHub account can change the branch contents at any time to deliver arbitrary code into the installer's environment, with no version pin, no hash, and no publisher relationship to the npm scope `@bellaxchan`. This is an off-registry, mutable dependency source rather than a pinned registry release.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
